title: Define Asteria Field landing region and canonical map package
description: Create the canonical description of Asteria Field, a clearly fictional Red Horizon operational designation inside the real Margaritifer Terra region of Mars. Describe the region at the same level of specificity as the RH-01 vehicle dossier: geographic context, geological history, mineralogy and habitability rationale, terrain, landing ellipse, engineering hazards, science zones, traverse constraints, communications considerations, and the distinction between real Mars facts and invented scenario details. Produce a coherent canonical map-image package for scenario planning. Do not publish the dossier or maps yet.
design: Use Asteria Field as a fictional mission designation within Margaritifer Terra. Maps must look like technical planning references rather than promotional art. Keep the scenario package separate from the public site until approved, and avoid implying an official IAU place name.
acceptance_criteria: A region dossier clearly marks Asteria Field as fictional while grounding it in cited real Mars context; the site supports Red Horizon's mineralogy and ancient-habitability goals; landing and rover-operability constraints are consistent with one another; at least three canonical PNG map images are produced—a whole-planet locator with target arrow, regional satellite-style view, and local landing/operations view—with scale, north indication, legend, labels, descriptive metadata, and provenance; the dossier and images are not published until separately approved.
notes: Human approved the Asteria Field dossier and map direction on 2026-09-16. The canonical PNG package was generated with the built-in GPT Image tool: AF-01 whole-planet Mars locator with an arrow targeting Asteria Field; AF-02 regional satellite-style view of the field envelope and terrain units; AF-03 zoomed local landing and operations view with the landing ellipse, P0, S1-S4 points of interest, routes, hazards, and communications shoulder. Files: docs/regions/asteria-field/maps/asteria-field-01-mars-locator.png; docs/regions/asteria-field/maps/asteria-field-02-regional-context.png; docs/regions/asteria-field/maps/asteria-field-03-local-operations.png. No publication or deployment performed. Validation: PNG signatures and dimensions verified, documentation links updated, and git diff --check passes.
close_reason: Dossier approved and canonical PNG map package generated and documented.

title: Define canonical Red Horizon mission scenario
description: Create the locked internal scenario baseline for the fictional Red Horizon Mars programme. Define the equal international partnership, governance, mineralogy and habitability objectives, mission architecture, fictional Asteria Field landing site context, Ariane 64 launch from Kourou, lifecycle budget with research/build/launch/operations breakdown, and an exact-day programme timeline from development through launch, landing, first onboard sample analysis, supported operations, and end of life. The scenario must remain clearly fictional and must not be written as public news.
design: Locked direction: Red Horizon; partners France, Germany, Estonia, Norway, Spain, Poland, Czechia, Slovakia, Japan, and Canada; no United States participation; equal governance; mineralogy and ancient-habitability focus; stationary lander relay plus rover direct-to-Earth backup; invented Asteria Field designation inside real Margaritifer Terra; Ariane 64 from Kourou; approximately EUR 2.1B lifecycle baseline subject to detailed derivation; exact calendar days required.
acceptance_criteria: One internal canonical scenario document records all approved mission decisions; partner responsibilities are plausible and equal-governed; FEI STU has a small technically credible Slovak contribution reserved for later mention; costs are explained by phase and include contingency; exact dates are checked against a plausible 2031 Mars transfer opportunity; the rover performs onboard collection and analysis only and never returns to Earth; design life targets two Mars years while funded operations/support are explicitly defined; private scenario material is not exposed publicly.
notes: Completed private locked scenario baseline at docs/timeline/000-mission-baseline.md. It defines the fictional programme, equal coalition governance, responsibilities including the limited FEI STU role, mineralogy/habitability objectives, Asteria Field boundary, flight architecture, onboard-only sample analysis, exact 2026-2036 calendar, EUR 2.10B lifecycle budget, risks, release controls, and primary grounding sources. Verified Dprint, whitespace, 1,374-day mission arithmetic, budget/funding totals, and source-link responses. Aligned timeline step 006 with the locked launch day. Detailed region dossier and maps remain in child task mars-ai-simulator-4te.1.
close_reason: Canonical private mission scenario documented and validated; follow-up region/map package remains tracked separately in mars-ai-simulator-4te.1.
